name: uibToolboxSysId
label: Toolbox component sys_id
description: The sys_id of the toolbox component record to set properties for

name: configLayout
label: Config layout
description: An array of configuration layout options for how to show properties in the properties pane

name: showEmptySections
label: Show empty sections
description: If true, sections with no properties will still render

name: scriptedConfigPolicy
label: Scripted config policy
description: A script to execute on load or when properties change their values

name: propertyDefinitions
label: Properties definitions
description: An array of custom property definitions to show in the properties pane

name: externalPropertyDefinitions
label: External properties definitions
description: An array of external property definitions to show in the properties pane

name: propertyValues
label: Property values
description: An object with name/value pairs of property names to UxValues

name: resolvedPropertyValues
label: Resolved property values
description: An object with name/value pairs of property names to scalar values

name: externalPropertyValues
label: External property values
description: An object with name/value pairs of external property names to UxValues

name: resolvedExternalPropertyValues
label: Resolved external property values
description: An object with name/value pairs of external property names to scalar values

name: scriptTemplate
label: Script template
description: The default string to use for a scripted property

name: scriptCompletions
label: Script completions
description: An object with the script completions to use for a scripted property

name: component
label: Component definition
description: The component definition for the component the props pane is editing

name: bindingEnabled
label: Bindings enabled
description: True if properties should be allowed to have bindings

name: scriptingEnabled
label: Scripting enabled
description: True if properties should be allowed to have scripts

name: disabled
label: Disabled
description: True if the properties pane should be disabled

name: presetValues
label: Preset values
description: Object containing values provided by the selected preset

name: externalPresetValues
label: External preset values
description: Object containing values provided by the selected external preset

name: theme
label: Theme
description: Object containing theme information

name: clientScripts
label: Client scripts
description: Array of client scripts associated to the macroponent

name: clientScriptApi
label: Client script API
description: Object containing the client script API

name: contextMetaData
label: Context meta data
description: Object containing contextual meta data objects for the properties pane

name: context
label: Context
description: The context the props-pane is operating within

name: draggedValue
label: Dragged value
description: A value being dragged in from another component

name: hostingComponent
label: Hosting component
description: The component elementLabel and elementId whose properties are being previewed

name: rootMacroponentProps
label: Root macroponent props
description: The macroponent props for the root macroponent being edited

name: builderMode
label: Builder Mode
description: Determines context of the current builder, like Page, Component, Controller, Preset, etc.

name: builderAssistantAlert
label: Builder Assistant Alert
description: Provides context around a builder assistant alert that has been activated
